General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Rear Gate/Tailgate Stop Limit Cable.
This cable bolts from the tailgate to the body and prevents the tailgate from opening to far.
Easy to Install!
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Stop/Limit Cable
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
